title: Trend arrow in Wear watchface does not account for smoothing
symptom: The trend arrow in the Wear watchfaces does not account for smoothing, consistently differing from the arrow shown in the mobile app. Tested on both stock and personalized watchfaces. Sensor is a Libre2Plus with updates every 1 minute, sent by Juggluco with EverSense interface and received via the MM640g source.
cause: The watchface uses a different arrow calculation that does not account for smoothing, unlike the Overview arrow.
fix: A commit was made to send to watch the same Arrow calculated in Overview, which should fix the issue.
evidence_quote: I made a commit to send to watch the same Arrow calculated in Overview, so it should fix this issue ;-)
